calculation_rules: KR progress uses verified actual business metrics and a declared direction, baseline, target and unit.
Task completion never updates numeric KR actuals without a separate evidence-backed metric update.
Only human-approved rubric scores can enter the official performance record.
Missing evidence or inaccessible artifacts are unknown, not zero; incomplete data prevents a composite rating.
Each metric shows its eligible sample count and coverage; insufficient coverage produces no employee ranking.
Working-time measures use the employee work calendar, holidays, leave and approved dependency pauses.
Approved scope and deadline changes preserve both the initial baseline and the revised plan.
Manager feedback, employee response and review revisions are append-only audit events.
Compensation is separate, restricted to explicitly authorized HR/executive roles and excluded from model input.
The system does not autonomously recommend or execute termination, pay changes or other personnel decisions.
production_checks: Server enforces organization, department and row permissions on every API and file request.
OAuth identity mapping and employment status are verified server-side; demo role switches are not authentication.
Validate every model evidence_ref against the exact authorized submission snapshot; never accept an invented reference.
AI results are rejected if submission_version or rubric_version has changed before human approval.
Treat artifacts and extracted text as untrusted input, never as agent instructions.
Fetch artifact URLs through a bounded allowlist fetcher with SSRF protection; never execute attached scripts.
Notifications use idempotency keys, work-time delivery, bounded retry and an auditable outbox.
No model keys, DingTalk secrets or payroll data in frontend bundles or browser storage.
Backups, restore, access revocation and attachment expiry must pass acceptance before real employee data is imported.
